chapter: Early string bands and first jobs
title: Forming a brass band around 1909
summary: Mello and others including Schilling, Eddie Riley and the Dykemans formed a brass band about 1909 while Fisher's band declined.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So everybody with the exception of Schilling and Philly Marsloff, but Marsloff wasn't in the brass band. Schilling took up ten of trombone. We got Eddie Riley, we got the two Dykemans, we got Roy Bridges, playing trap drums with us then. We formed a brass band and the brass band stuck, oh I guess in about 1909. The Fisher still had his band, he had Richie Brunus leading it, but he didn't go too far with it. What did Marsloff play? Marsloff's guitar. Paper hang about that, guitar play about that. And the Dyke ones, what are they?
